channel.title: SMS Campaign Manager — Product Releases & Updates
channel.description: Latest releases, feature changelogs, and technical updates for SMS Campaign Manager by Evostackr.

item.title: v1.0 Production Release: Native Android Bulk SMS Marketing Engine
item.description: Official release of SMS Campaign Manager v1.0. Features include direct Dual-SIM routing, CSV contact deduplication, dynamic template variable substitution, persistent foreground service dispatch with WakeLock, and local AES-256 encrypted database storage.

item.title: Feature Highlight: Intelligent CSV Ingestion & E.164 Number Normalization
item.description: The ContactImporter and PhoneValidator engines now scrub dirty contact lists in seconds, purging duplicate entries and formatting phone numbers into standard E.164 format with zero cloud dependency.

item.title: Feature Highlight: Real-time GSM 7-bit & UCS-2 Unicode Segment Calculator
item.description: Built-in SMS segment calculator dynamically detects non-GSM characters and displays exact multipart SMS message billing boundaries before launching a campaign.

item.title: Privacy Commitment: 100% On-Device Offline Operation
item.description: Evostackr reiterates its commitment to zero telemetry: no external cloud servers, no analytics trackers, and complete user ownership of confidential customer contact directories.
